stem: A car salesman placed this advertisement in the newspaper: "Old and new cars for sale, different prices, average price 5,000 zeds." From the advertisement, which of the following must be true?

options.label: A
options.text: Most of the cars would cost between 4,000 zeds and 6,000 zeds.

options.label: B
options.text: Half of the cars would cost less than 5,000 zeds, and half would cost more than 5,000 zeds.

options.label: C
options.text: At least one of the cars would cost 5,000 zeds.

options.label: D
options.text: Some of the cars would cost less than 5,000 zeds.
